text: Nobody actually runs out of time. You just trade hours for things you won't remember by Friday.

text: Every January we swear this is the year we lock in. By February we're optimizing our recovery from planning.

text: Busyness feels like progress because your brain confuses noise with momentum. Checking ten boxes doesn't mean you moved an inch.
